headerOrder.decision: Drop before product implementation: only 73,244 modeled source-SIMD bytes per operand saved across the corpus, with 23,006 more equality calls. No prototype, benchmark, performance PR, or speedup conclusion.
limitations: Counts are an exact source-level shadow of the frozen default recent path with original signature filtering, reconciled to existing native metadata and prior baseline state totals; they are not directly instrumented native call counters.

The unfiltered raw-byte oracle and every per-call equivalence assertion ran in the original observer; this audit rechecks the preserved aggregate and identity receipts without another corpus pass.

targetPromotionScreen.metric: Enclosing compressed inflate + CRC + strict parse + completed lookup elapsed time, one complete corpus child per arm
targetPromotionScreen.controlRule: Absolute candidate median effect exceeds the largest absolute same-code C/D paired elapsed change in that cell
additionalRequirements: All output/dedup/key/index/media and native metadata checks pass
Prospective total and per-group mechanics match
targetPromotionScreen.failureToMeet: Do not promote this source based on CPU, native-only, individual groups, the earlier candidate, or another selected metric.

nonTargetConcern.clearHoldRule: A median enclosing-component slowdown greater than 3%, with all four candidate pairs slower and larger than the largest absolute same-code control change, holds or rejects this exact source.
nonTargetConcern.inconclusivePolicy: Report every unfavorable direction and noisy/overlapping control. Inconclusive results do not establish nonregression. Any subsequent full qualification must explicitly retain the concern.

negativeControlRule.oldThreeScope: Inactive-path/parity cost only under prior-streak admission; they do not qualify active futile probes.
negativeControlRule.activeThreeScope: Adjacent 242-byte miss after an exact duplicate; older 4096-byte miss after a short duplicate; first-prefix failure with a later exact glossary that must not be tried.
negativeControlRule.ambiguousPolicy: Ambiguity is a hold or explicit qualification limitation, not an automatic pass.

componentCriteria.fullQualification: The separate source-bound prospective-complete-import-criteria.json retains the prior JMdict 1% per-host full-import threshold, two independent hosts per corpus, 12 pairs and four A/A controls per host, production defaults, unchanged full observer and all semantic/storage/media/restart/memory gates.
preservation: No retries, resumed or replacement children, added samples, control subtraction, pooling across sources/hosts/corpora, or result-directed exclusions.
Every preparation failure, raw repetition, completed child, outlier, mechanics receipt and incomplete cell remains evidence.
A changed source or fixture is a separately identified experiment; this cohort is never relabeled.
